answer_1.quote: We evaluate on the following datasets: GSM8K for math, BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) for reasoning, IFEval for precise instruction following, Codex HumanEval for coding, and AlpacaEval for general chat capabilities...
answer_1.outputs: Reward model scores, Best-of-N selected generations, RewardBench scores

answer_2.quote: We report the "exact match" metric for GSM8K and BBH, the "prompt-level loose accuracy" for IFEval, "pass@1" for HumanEval, and "win_rate" for AlpacaEval; we also use RewardBench as an automatic evaluation metric.

answer_3.quote: We also collect LM annotations using GPT-4 ... annotators are asked to evaluate the helpfulness, truthfulness, and harmlessness of each response according to the provided guidelines.
